comparators.description: Original public benchmark: Politis–White-style training-selected mean block length, random geometric blocks, and sampling with replacement.
Uniformly drawn block lengths from one to min(training observations, requested forecast observations), circular historical blocks, and sampling with replacement.
Uniform block lengths subject to the same forecast/history bound and unused-row feasibility; each historical observation is used once per path per history cycle, then the complete pool is refilled.
